Philly Reads Philly is back in October, and our next read is Beautyland by Marie-Helene Bertino.
Beautyland follows Adina, a girl born in Philadelphia who believes she’s been sent to Earth by extraterrestrials to report back on what it means to be human. As she grows up, she sends observations about everything from family and friendship to loneliness, love, grief, and the general strangeness of being alive.
Join us at At My House for a casual discussion of the book - what we loved, what we didn’t, what stuck with us. You don’t need to come prepared with anything other than having read as much…

Join us for the PHP×Philly October meetup:
Whimsy Tank: A Shark Tank for Silly Ideas
Inspired by Christina Martinez's Whimsy-Driven Development talk, this month's PHP×Philly is a pitch competition where the business that brings the biggest smile gets a deal.
Bring a project you built for fun. Pitch it to our judges. You'll be scored on whimsy, silliness, and how little money it could ever make. Nobody cares about market size. We care about whether it made you giggle while you built it.
